Poster

1024 × 1280 · 4:5send as photo

Copy image is the one button a browser can refuse: putting a PNG on the clipboard goes through the permission-gated Clipboard API, which is withheld on plenty of local pages. When it says Blocked, use Save PNG and drag the file in — or drag docs/release-notes/v0.22.2-poster.png straight from the repo, which is the same bytes and skips the clipboard entirely. The caption buttons need no clipboard permission, so they are not the ones to worry about here. On a phone: press and hold the poster, then Save to Photos — and press and hold a caption rather than trusting its button — a phone browser is the case least tested here.

English

🎤 SingZ v0.22.2 — the sample song keeps singing when you put the phone down

The song that comes with SingZ used to stop the moment you left the app or locked the phone. It always plays on the older of the app's two audio engines — it is unpacked from inside the app rather than read from files — and leaving the app silenced that engine whatever it was doing, so any song playing on it went quiet too.

Now it carries on behind the Home Screen, and the Lock Screen's play, pause and scrub bar reach it while it does.

Nothing changes on the computer, and nothing here touches a song you already have.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone (TestFlight): https://testflight.apple.com/join/q6vVdkwt

Russian

🎤 SingZ v0.22.2 — песня-образец продолжает играть, когда телефон убран в карман

Песня, которая идёт в комплекте с SingZ, замолкала, стоило выйти из приложения или заблокировать телефон. Она всегда играет на старом из двух звуковых движков приложения — распаковывается из самого приложения, а не читается из файлов, — а выход из приложения выключал этот движок в любом случае, и замолкала любая песня на нём.

Теперь она играет за домашним экраном, а Play, пауза и перемотка с экрана блокировки до неё доходят.

На компьютере ничего не меняется, и ни одна ваша песня не затронута.

Mac, Windows, Android: https://github.com/lexasoft123/SingZ/releases/latest
iPhone (TestFlight): https://testflight.apple.com/join/q6vVdkwt

Telegram allows 1024 characters on a photo caption and recompresses photos past ~1280 px on the long side — this poster is 1280 on its long side, so sending it as a photo costs nothing. Poster file: docs/release-notes/v0.22.2-poster.png
